name: mirage
text: Checked the live engine now. All four are running on sockets: Novig (read-only key, websocket on, 16 reads a second), Kalshi (live, 15,085 of 15,085 markets), PropLine (live, about 4.9 million markets confirmed current, 0 gaps), and ParlayAPI (live; hot leagues covered). SX Bet is live too. In the phone settings every socket switch is on. Not running: BoltOdds (its API is switched off, so no socket) and SharpAPI's (needs the paid add-on). One real gap to chase: ParlayAPI's board reports 25,457 rows it reads but doesn't price, mostly player props (3,674), spreads (3,032) and totals. I'll find out whether that's by design or lost coverage and fix it if it's lost. Also landed on main: the Virginia/West Virginia and Mo/Moe name fixes (3,012 tests green).
